title: A schematic with buses: a vector with a group name, a named bus, a name that is not a vector, a bus with no wire
how: The bus `B[0..2],ENA` holds the vector B[0..2] (members B0, B1, B2) and the name ENA, which is no vector (a note); the bus `Z:Q[0..1]` holds the vector Q[0..1] after the colon; `[0..3]` has no name for its members and `EMPTY[0..1]` has no wire: 2 buses of the model;
nets of the sheet: B1, B2, B0, B7 and Q1 = 5 nets (a net with no pin is kept);

entries: B1 has an end at (0, 5) on the bus wire from (0, 0) to (0, 20); B2 ends at (0, 12) on it (its second end); B0 has no end on the wire (the cross product of (3, 5) is -60, not 0); B7 is no member; Q1 has an end at (50, 2) on the second bus = 3 entries;
notes of code PHOENIX-EAGLE-022: the label of the first bus, the name ENA, the name [0..3], and the bus without a wire; one sheet; no part and no symbol.
